cohort: The study participants were 8 mid-gestation fetal sheep exposed to normoxic or hypoxic conditions and 7 control fetuses, observed over approximately 22 days.
finding: Chronic fetal hypoxia leads to white matter hyper-vascularity, decreased neuronal density, and impaired myelination in fetal sheep brains.
gest_age: Mid-gestation (at start of experiment); 133 ± 4 days (for control harvest)
